timed_costs_include: binary interval search on nonuniform adaptive knots
exp reconstruction for log(C) and log(K)
logistic Se reconstruction for the logit candidate
finding: Both adaptive lookup forms are faster than the direct analytical smooth-core evaluator for all four tested materials in this optimized-Fortran microbenchmark.
secondary_finding: The lower-support logit(Se) representation is not uniformly the fastest representation; B12 favors direct-theta lookup. Support count and runtime cost must therefore remain separate selection criteria.
nonclaims: This is not an end-to-end Richards speedup.
This does not include one-time build cost.
This does not qualify branch handling outside h <= Hcrit.
This does not admit any production implementation.
next_gate: F-AHL04 end-to-end research-provider replay against the analytical Richards provider, with build cost, solver iterations, accepted trajectories, mass balance and total runtime measured together.
